author: (Edmunds, 1963)

familyName.es: Babosas de mar de dos valvas

note.en: A bivalved sea slug under 4 mm long, with a clam-like shell, known here from museum specimens at Manzanillo, 5 to 25 m, in 2000 and 2001.
note.es: Una babosa de mar bivalva de menos de 4 mm, con una concha parecida a la de una almeja, conocida aquí por ejemplares de museo de Manzanillo, entre 5 y 25 m, en 2000 y 2001.

evidence: GBIF: 4 museum specimens recorded as Berthelinia caribbea (a former name), Manzanillo, 2000 and 2001

sources.t: WoRMS / MolluscaBase: valid name and distribution
